_about: Public-domain Henry Allon (1818-1892), Congregational minister of Union Chapel, Islington, and editor of the British Quarterly Review, for the Word Hoard: The Vision of God and Other Sermons (1876) and The Indwelling Christ and Other Sermons (1892), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 58 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
